تنتقلين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِلِينَ (tantaqilīna) /tan.ta.qi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# تُنْتَقَلِينَ (tuntaqalīna) /tun.ta.qa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
